author: claude
text:
docs: align ARCHITECTURE.md to TAXONOMY.md terms

Rewrite ARCHITECTURE.md against the agreed terms table: conversation,
exchange, invocation, step, model call, tool call, API call, branch,
dispatch, goal. Abolish turn, session, compression (context sense),
and bare call. Split Tools/Skills as separate primitives. Set pass@1
with Wilson CI as primary suite metric. Amend AGENTS.md with a
Terminology Discipline section that requires terms of art to be
defined in the taxonomy or introducing document, else user approval.
